title: Good opportunities now arrive faster than a small team can act on them, and admin is what slows everything down.
context: Reimbursements, bank reconciliations, client invoicing and grant reporting are done by hand, and most of how they work lives in one director's head. Contracting has no written procedure. An operations hire is coming, but not for a while, and the team wants the groundwork laid before they start.
postedBy: A research lead at a small policy-research organisation
